title: Nâng cấp giao diện menu khách hàng và sửa khóa khung giờ
rootCause: Customer menu controls have inconsistent iconography and touch sizing, the sort control has no dedicated styling, mobile cards remain vertically long, restaurant discovery has no search, and initialTimeSlot is incorrectly reused as the booking-locked slot for normal remote ordering.
flow: publicRestaurants -> RestaurantMenu discovery -> customerMenuCategories/menuItemsConnection -> MenuDetailView filters -> MenuItemCard -> FoodDetail -> cart hold

completed: Traced publicRestaurants, customerMenuCategories, menuItemsConnection, menu availability and food-detail navigation without changing their contracts.
Separated initialTimeSlot from lockedTimeSlot and added regression coverage for normal versus booking menu switching.
Added restaurant discovery search, styled menu controls, result context, low-stock metadata and compact phone cards.
Parsed all changed JSX and tests successfully with esbuild.
Compiled RestaurantMenu, MenuDetailView, MenuDetailViewPolish and MenuItemCard SCSS successfully with Sass.
Re-fetched changed files from main and confirmed no conflict markers.
notRun: Vitest and the full Vite build were not run because this workspace has no repository checkout or installed project dependencies.
Interactive browser review at 390x844, 430x932, 768, 1024 and 1440 remains pending.
